partsInIdlePose: Every standing pose is built from the same layers (in z-order): tail nub (~81x34, yellow), left foot and right foot (~73x40 ellipses, #F7673B), body (~193x163, #FFC954), head (~282x259 open path, #FFC954), left wing and right wing (~45x38 U-shapes), hair tuft (~129x74), eyes (30x30 dark circles, replaced by lines/arcs in some poses), beak (~135x56, #F7673B), two tiny nostril strokes. Extras per pose: brows/closed-eye lines (~52x8), smile-eye arcs (~51x29), tears/drops, toothpick (thinking), dangling round feet (~67x67) when dragged. Outline #232323, stroke-width 6 (in Figma units), round caps/joins.
